question.text: Which bond has the HIGHEST interest-rate sensitivity?

explanation.text: The Logic: Source p.66 says bond price volatility is inversely related to coupon and directly related to term to maturity, so a longer-maturity, lower-coupon bond has the highest sensitivity. Source p.67 ties greater duration to greater bond-price volatility. The Trap: Higher coupons and shorter maturities reduce duration and dampen interest-rate sensitivity. Note: Duration captures both effects from pp.66-67 in a single number.
